## 1. Professional Overview
Geoffrey Githii is a versatile systems engineer and protocol architect delivering production systems across Web3, decentralized finance, mobile client architecture, and distributed cloud computing from 2022 to the present. He blends front-of-the-screen product execution (Flutter, React) with protocol mechanics (EVM smart contracts, Solidity) and cloud/edge infrastructure (Firebase, Cloudflare Workers, Node.js).

---

## 2. Technical Track Record & Ventures

### Moonlist Ecosystem
- Role: Founder & Architect
- Period: 2026 – Present (Current)
- Category: Web3 & Distributed Architecture
- Scope & Achievements:
  - Engineered an AI-driven multi-chain cryptocurrency aggregator and real-time portfolio analytics dashboard.
  - Implemented non-custodial transaction execution pipelines enabling users to track and trade across multiple blockchains securely.
  - Designed cross-platform application structures deployed seamlessly across web and mobile clients.
  - Tech Stack: Flutter, React, Multi-Chain Aggregation, AI Analytics, Non-Custodial Pipelines.

### Solerium & GOATS Miniapp
- Role: Full-Stack Engineer
- Period: 2024 – 2025
- Category: Full-Stack Web & Miniapp Architecture
- Scope & Achievements:
  - Designed and engineered high-engagement interactive miniapps and user-facing modules optimized for viral community onboarding.
  - Optimized client-server state synchronization under high concurrent traffic, minimizing latency and transaction dropped states.
  - Tech Stack: Full-Stack JavaScript/TypeScript, Interactive Miniapps, High Concurrency Optimization, Performance Tuning.

### Hashbit Org
- Role: Lead Smart Contract Developer
- Period: 2022 – 2024
- Category: Smart Contracts & Protocol Engineering
- Scope & Achievements:
  - Spearheaded smart contract development, protocol logic optimization, and security architecture across EVM-compatible networks.
  - Implemented custom fee routing mechanics and liquidity management smart contracts.
  - Conducted extensive smart contract optimization and security testing cycles across EVM testnets and mainnets.
  - Tech Stack: Solidity, EVM Networks, Fee Routing Architecture, Liquidity Management, Contract Optimization.

### Docswap Exchange
- Role: Smart Contract & Frontend Developer
- Period: 2024
- Category: Decentralized Exchange (DEX)
- Scope & Achievements:
  - Contributed to decentralized exchange infrastructure by optimizing token swap execution pathways, significantly reducing slippage and routing overhead.
  - Developed real-time analytical dashboards providing liquidity providers with actionable fee and volume metrics.
  - Tech Stack: Solidity, Web3 Frontend, DEX Smart Contracts, Token Swap Execution, Analytics.

### Cross-Platform Mobile Clients
- Role: Flutter & Dart Engineer
- Period: Ongoing
- Category: Mobile Architecture
- Scope & Achievements:
  - Built production-ready mobile applications featuring responsive layouts for both iOS and Android from a single unified codebase.
  - Engineered resilient local data caching mechanisms for smooth offline capability and connected reactive state management with REST and GraphQL APIs.
  - Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Reactive State Management, Local Data Caching, REST & GraphQL Pipelines.

## 3. Technical Proficiencies & Skills Matrix

### Client Layer (Frontend & Mobile)
- Flutter & Dart: Cross-platform mobile development, clean architecture, BLoC / Riverpod / Provider state management.
- React & TypeScript: Modern component design, hooks, reactive UI, state management, Vite bundling.
- UI/UX & Responsive Web: Tailwind CSS, modern CSS variable architecture, accessible dark/light theming.

### Protocol Layer (Web3 & Smart Contracts)
- Languages: Solidity.
- Environment: EVM-compatible blockchains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, etc.).
- Concepts: Tokenomics, Custom Fee Routing, Automated Market Makers (AMM), Liquidity Management, Smart Contract Auditing & Security.

### Backend & Distributed Systems
- Edge & Serverless: Cloudflare Edge Workers, Firebase Cloud Functions.
- Runtimes: Node.js, Express.
- Protocols & APIs: RESTful API design, GraphQL schemas, WebSockets.
- Blockchain Infrastructure: Multi-Chain RPC node management, event indexing.

### Infrastructure & DevOps
- Version Control: Git, GitHub.
- Automation: GitHub Actions, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.
- Hosting & Delivery: Cloudflare Pages, Edge CDN, Vite build pipeline.
